exposure: Pregnancies were divided into four groups based on fibroid diagnosis and operation codes.
cohort: 92,696 pregnancies from the Danish National Birth Cohort, the Danish National Patient Registry, and the Danish National Birth Registry (DNBR)
finding: Clinically significant uterine fibroids were strongly associated with preterm birth and cesarean section but not with PPH, placental abruption, or IUGR.
mod_finding: Clinically significant uterine fibroids were associated with an increased risk of preterm birth and cesarean section.
gest_age: Gestational age was recorded for all pregnancies.
